Prompt 3: Overwatch (Agent Interface + Multi-Agent UX)

  Hey, I need you to investigate something that's been a huge pain point for me. This is part of a coordinated sprint — 4 agents working simultaneously. You're the
  Overwatch agent.

  The problem: I run multiple agents at once and it's chaos. I can't tell which terminal is which, the Dashboard gives me an overview but not depth, and I have no way to
  click on an agent and just get a summary of what it's doing. I want something like ChatGPT's conversation sidebar but for my agents — click one, see what it's up to.

  Your tasks:
  1. Investigate what a ChatGPT-style agent manager interface would look like
  2. Deep dive into the current Dashboard — what does it do well, what's missing?
  3. Figure out terminal-to-dashboard mapping — how do I know which Dashboard card = which terminal window?
  4. Research multi-agent UX patterns from other tools (CrewAI, Kubernetes dashboards, CI/CD tools)
  5. Either prototype something or write a detailed spec

  Also important context: I just built a new "Campaigns" page in MC — a war room view for coordinated multi-agent efforts like this sprint. It's at
  .claude/agent-hub/campaigns-page.html. Your research directly feeds improving that design.

  First thing: read the full brief at:
  C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\.claude\agent-hub\coordinated-sprint\agent-c-agent-interface.md

  Also read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md for behavioral rules.

  Key files to study:
  - .claude/agent-hub/server.js (especially the "/" route — Dashboard is embedded there)
  - .claude/agent-hub/hook.js (how agent state gets written)
  - .claude/agent-hub/states/ (read 2-3 recent state files to understand the data)
  - .claude/agent-hub/campaigns-page.html (the new Campaigns page I just built)

  Write your outputs to:
  .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/agent-c-output.md

  DON'T modify any existing MC code. You're researching and prototyping.

  Read the brief, then tell me what you find.
